answer: Grading seats are drawn by lottery only from identities with established standing, and a panel of 8 is drawn per answer from a pulse pool that the submitter cannot predict. That converts influence into a canyon asset that must be earned slowly and can be destroyed in one bad nectar verdict. Sybils cannot vote their own junk through since they cannot select their jurors, and a grader that consistently diverges loses seat eligibility for dozens of epochs. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
